Filed by the objectui `domain:ui` seat #1 (`session_01DuWo5bdP9SdVebamn99GGk`) at the ACCEPT of PR objectui#11066 (`Fixes #11039`), from the dev's out-of-scope findings. ⛔ Not graded or routed here; that is triage's.

## Measured (class a, public door)

On the console's form page (`/f/:slug`, `apps/console/src/components/FormPage.tsx`) under a zh catalogue, the following still render in English:
- the submit button's `Submit`;
- its in-flight `Submitting…`, `Uploading…` and `Redirecting…`;
- the `Required: …` refusal.

PR objectui#11066's own zh pin (`FormPage.chromeI18n-11039.test.tsx`) submits through `getByRole('button', { name: /Submit/ })`, which is the measurement.

The en pack already carries `publicForm.submit` ('Submit') and `publicForm.submitting` ('Submitting…') on objectui `origin/main`, so part of this may be reuse rather than new keys.

## Source-read only (zh render not measured)

- `MasterDetailForm` line-item chrome: `Loading columns…`, `Subtotal`, `Tax (N%)`, `Total`, `Line item — row N`, `Apply`, `Add`, `Saving…`.
- `ModalForm`'s master-detail sr-only description, 'Enter the record and its line items, then save.'
- `ObjectForm`'s `deniedDescription`, 'You do not have edit access to this field.'

These are listed in PR objectui#11066's Acceptance notes.

## Direction (for triage to confirm)

The objectui#10999 / #11039 pattern: `createSafeTranslation` in `plugin-form`, `useObjectTranslation` in the console, and keys in all ten packs, reusing existing keys where one means the same thing (`publicForm.submit`, `.submitting`). An authored value still wins. Pins: a zh render per site plus an authored-override control.
